English: Snow Shelter
A crude, snow-packed structure offering basic shelter for the faithful against the harsh arctic winds.
Ice Altar
An altar of packed snow and carved ice blocks, where rites are performed in the biting cold.
Fur-Lined Chapel
A small wooden chapel, lined with animal furs to provide warmth and comfort for worshippers.
Snowbank Sanctuary
A sturdy sanctuary of timber and packed snow, with dedicated space for meditation and communal prayer.
Insulated Chapel
A stone chapel with layered insulation of moss, furs, and timber, providing protection from the cold and spiritual threats.
Stone Arctic Chapel
A grand structure of heavy stone, with high walls and a great hearth, symbolizing the endurance of the faith in frozen lands.
Enclosed Snow Sanctuary
A majestic sanctuary with double stone walls, intricate insulation, and domed snow roofs, hosting learned clergy and rituals.
Heated Sanctuary
A marvel of arctic architecture, this sanctuary boasts advanced heating channels, vast libraries, and secure vaults for relics.
Arctic Gathering Hall
An immense arctic hall, both fortress and house of worship, where pilgrims and clergy gather for great councils.
Arctic Temple
A legendary temple, center of arctic faith, with monumental shrines, storied halls, and archives of ancient knowledge.
